title: Login scripts do not work if they are in a hidden directory or are a hidden file themselves
line: A hidden login script such as ~/.script.sh now runs at login and stays listed on the Autostart page.
explanation: AutostartModel::addScript() named the generated entry after the script file, so ~/.script.sh became ~/.config/autostart/.script.sh.desktop, a hidden file. Hidden .desktop files are skipped both by the login autostart runner and by the Autostart page's own listing, so the script never ran and disappeared from the page once it was reopened; logout scripts got a hidden symlink in plasma-workspace/shutdown the same way. The change strips leading dots from the generated entry/symlink name; the entry still executes the hidden script and the page still shows its real name. Scripts inside a hidden folder already worked.

commits.message:
kcms/autostart: run and list hidden login and logout scripts

Adding a hidden script such as ~/.script.sh created the hidden entry
.script.sh.desktop, which is never run and is skipped when the page
lists entries. Drop the leading dots from the entry and symlink names.

BUG: 478662

From 479549639ea349924daf59f2dc5b7b51b9f530b2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:39:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcms/autostart: run and list hidden login and logout scripts

Adding a hidden script such as ~/.script.sh created the hidden entry
.script.sh.desktop, which is never run and is skipped when the page
lists entries. Drop the leading dots from the entry and symlink names.

BUG: 478662
---
 kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp b/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
index 16609b873b..49b0e77d26 100644
--- a/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
+++ b/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
@@ -395,6 +395,9 @@ void AutostartModel::addScript(const QUrl &url, AutostartModel::AutostartEntrySo
     }
 
     QString fileName = url.fileName();
+    while (fileName.startsWith(QLatin1Char('.'))) {
+        fileName.remove(0, 1);
+    }
 
     if (kind == AutostartModel::AutostartEntrySource::XdgScripts) {
         int lastLoginScript = -1;
--
